content: दाक्षिण्य {%a.%} [दक्षिणस्य भावः ष्यञ्] Relating to a sacrificial gift. .{@-ण्यम्@} .²1 .³({%a%}) Politeness, civility, courtesy; तस्य दाक्षिण्यरूढेन नाम्ना मगधवंशजा <ls>R. 1. 31</ls>. .³({%b%}) Kindness; <ls>V. 1. 2</ls>; दाक्षिण्यं स्वजने <ls>Bh. 2. 22</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1. 8</ls>. .²2 Insincere or overcourteous conduct of a lover (towards his beloved); दाक्षिण्येन ददाति वाचमुचिताम् <ls>Ś. 6. 4</ls>; it is thus defined:-- दाक्षिण्यं चेष्टया वाचा परचित्तानुवर्तनम्. .²3 The state of relating to or coming from the south; स्नेहदाक्षिण्ययोर्योगात् कामीव प्रतिभाति मे <ls>V. 2. 4</ls> (where the word has sense 1 or 2 also). .²4 Concord, harmony, agreement. .²5 Honesty, candour. .²6 Talent, cleverness.
